curriculum.lesson_evidence: Shared Australian civic values often taught in schools include respect, equality before the law, freedom within the law, fairness and caring for others and Country — explored through examples, not slogans alone.

lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Give a school example of fairness and a community example of respect.

FEEDBACK
Any concrete pair linked to equal rules / considerate behaviour.

WATCH FOR
Posting values posters without practising them is empty.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Values evidence folio: five values with one school and one community example each. Note one value people might disagree about and how to discuss calmly.

Write a short reflection naming one source or idea you corrected and why.

This helps the learner base claims on sources, places and respectful community knowledge, rather than guessing from a single picture. Keep every claim linked to evidence.
